title: Unsupervised Image Decomposition with Phase-Correlation Networks
description: Decomposing images into object components with frequency-domain neural networks.
body: Our work, Unsupervised Image Decomposition with Phase-Correlation Networks, was accepted for publication at VISAPP 2022.
PCDNet decomposes an image in a fully unsupervised manner into object components represented as transformed versions of learned object prototypes.
